Revenue Department Order P161/2566: Section41 foreign-income remittances
sources.note: Administrative interpretation of Section41. Applies to remittances from1January2024; P162 excludes income arising before1January2024 from P161 clause1. Income-year residence and income tracing required. Official PDF incorporates P162 amendment; not unamended original.

sources.title: Revenue Department Order P162/2566: Section41 foreign-income remittances
sources.note: Administrative interpretation of Section41. Applies to remittances from1January2024; P162 excludes income arising before1January2024 from P161 clause1. Income-year residence and income tracing required. Amends P161 clause1 by adding pre2024-income exclusion.
